description: The Project for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (PPCA) is a mod that is being planned to promote the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA), adding animal care and first aid items to Minecraft, encouraging players to protect and save animals.

mods.name: The Project for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
mods.description: The Project for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals will give you more item for heal the animal.
